name: Bloodban: The Undeadseeker
detailed_description:
Bloodban: The Undeadseeker is a dark-themed game about hunting monsters and the undead while exploring shadowy locations and solving ancient puzzles left behind by a forgotten civilization that hides the origins of these monsters.

HUNT MONSTERS AND THE UNDEAD!

Become a feared and cunning monster hunter who uses mystical and alchemical arts to identify and retaliate against the weaknesses of these creatures. Vampires, undead, cursed beings, and creatures of the night will be your main targets in this corrupted world.

In Bloodban: The Undeadseeker, you'll explore forests, ancient castles, ruins, villages, and dungeons in search of monsters. Not every place is easily accessible in these lands, so you'll need to solve puzzles that block your path to new areas with more monsters, items, and secrets.

DEFEAT ENEMIES WITH POWER

Throughout the game, you'll encounter creatures that require specific potions and spells to defeat. To acquire these spells, you'll need to accept contracts and follow dangerous routes leading to forgotten grimoires and rare ingredients.

Each spell or potion can be found in a specific area and can be equipped to hunt more powerful monsters or complete side missions in previously explored regions.

OBJECTIVES AND MISSIONS

Your goal as a hunter is simple: accept contracts, track monsters, and eliminate them.

But in the game, you can also seek new spells, collect ingredients for rare potions, encounter unique enemies, and uncover other dark secrets and mysteriously secretive mysteries...

PUZZLES AND ENVIRONMENTAL CHALLENGES

Throughout the game, you'll encounter environmental puzzles in crypts, dungeons, and abandoned temples where an ancient civilization built a system of defenses to guard a great secret.

Push boxes, statues, press buttons, unlock passages, and solve all the challenges and puzzles set by the ancients to unravel the mystery of that civilization.

CORE MECHANICS AND FEATURES

  • Real-time combat.

  • Top-down view.

  • Alchemical potion crafting system.

  • Spellcasting system

  • Base building

  • Environmental puzzles

  • Sokoban elements
